_readme: COMPOSITIONAL abstention cases: every component is real, only the combination
never happened. These are the hard kind. The generated set's own abstention
cases are FOREIGN subjects (a Fastly CDN migration, a Kubernetes rollout) that
share no vocabulary with the corpus and are easy to refuse - measured
2026-09-10, the shipped judge catches 3 of 5 of those and 1 of 4 of these.
Safe to commit to a public repo: a question about something that never
happened contains no archive content by construction. That is why this file
exists while benchmarks/eval_cases.json stays gitignored.
THEY DECAY ON USE. Asking one of these questions in a live session puts the
words into the index, and the case stops being a negative. one negative case
went from 0 hits to 1 within an hour of being used as a test.
ALWAYS run scripts/verify_abstention_cases.mjs before trusting a score.
terms = ILIKE fragments that must ALL appear in one message for the subject
to count as present. Keep them broad; a narrow term makes absence trivial
and the case worthless.
THIS IS THE TEMPLATE. Copy to abstention_hard.json (gitignored) and replace
the cases with compounds from YOUR OWN corpus - both components real, the
combination absent. Generic examples cannot work: a subject your archive has
never heard of is a FOREIGN negative, which is the easy kind this file exists
to stop measuring.

cases.q: what did we decide about the <CLIENT> loyalty points scheme
cases.why: a real client, and a plausible feature that was never discussed

cases.q: how did the <PROJECT> <PLAUSIBLE INTEGRATION> work go
cases.why: both components appear in the corpus separately; the pairing does not
